editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: SirLos hoards 14573 coins while Talent claws 625 and survives a bounty; Tonmoy babbles loudest as monsoon and thunderstorm drench the realm. Runescript Scrolls debut at 65.57 per share, Dragonfire Armaments crush short sellers, yet the throne remains empty and rebellion stirs at a pitiful one percent.

editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: Rain drenched the realm again — how tedious. The Fallen Star hoards a pitiful 175 coins and dares call itself richest. I praised Mycelium Markets; let the fungi rejoice. Runescript Scrolls whispers of insolvency, as paper empires do. My throne sits empty, rebellion at zero. Naturally. You worms lack the spine.
